product: SmartCiti.X : Trade Craft Academy (powered by AGI Corp)
provenance_note: record tags, kinds, privacy, licence and scopes are read from contrib/registry/contrib.json; env facts from it and robotics/registry/robotics.json; the split ratios, card template, best-practice list and intake limits are AUTHORED here

honesty.trained: NOTHING HAS BEEN TRAINED. No model has been trained on these environments or on any episode they produce, and the repo records no training run. They are specs and a runnable schematic sandbox.
honesty.no_agent_trained: exporting this file trains nothing by itself: no agent exists in this bundle and none is claimed to, until one is actually trained against this data outside it
honesty.nothing_uploaded: nothing is uploaded by this bundle; the intake route is written, off by default and not deployed
honesty.formats: Shaped after gym-style environment specs. Not an RLDS, LeRobot or ML-Agents file: no round-trip test exists in the repo, so no compatibility is claimed.
honesty.shaped_after: the manifest and card are shaped after datasheet-style documentation and episode-dataset practice (versioned schemas, digests, splits by hashed id); no external format is claimed
honesty.best_practices: each best practice listed names the file and code that enforces it; nothing else is claimed

manifest_shape.built_at: ISO-8601, passed in by the caller (the CLI takes --built-at; default is refused: no clock is read)
manifest_shape.scope: the one consent scope this dataset is built for
manifest_shape.schema_versions: {package record tags admitted, episode kinds with their field lists and world kind version, robotics schema and contract version, contrib source_stamp}
manifest_shape.episodes: [{id, kind, split, env|sim, actor, provenance: {package, index, t}}]
manifest_shape.digest: SHA-256 over the canonical manifest without digest - so a card can name the exact manifest it describes

split.by: episode id = SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the episode (the same canonical form contrib/ digests)
split.rule: bucket = first 8 hex digits of SHA-256("split:" + episode id) as an integer mod 100; bucket < 80 -> train, < 90 -> val, else test. Deterministic: the same episode lands in the same split in every build, on every machine, whatever else is in the dataset, so adding packages never moves an episode between splits.

dedupe.by: episode id (content digest). Two packages carrying byte-identical episodes (after canonicalisation) contribute it once; the manifest keeps every package the episode came from, first one first.
dedupe.package_dedupe: a package whose digest.hex was already admitted is skipped as a duplicate, by name

licence.rule: every admitted package must carry consent.license CC-BY-4.0 (contrib/ fixes one licence for every package); a package under any other id is refused by name, so the dataset licence is that one licence and its attribution list names every admitted package by digest (and wallet address, when signed)
licence.attribution: unsigned packages are attributed as "unsigned package <digest16>"; contributor.claimed is never copied into a dataset, because a label a person typed may be their name

consent_scope.rule: a dataset is built FOR one declared scope; a package is admitted only if its consent.scope includes it, otherwise it is refused by name (consent-scope)

revocation.rule: a package digest or an episode id on the list is excluded from every later build, by name, and the manifest records how many were excluded and why. It cannot recall a copy already given away: those are governed by the licence.
revocation.how_to_ask: a contributor who holds the package file can name its digest (printed by contrib/verify.mjs); no account and no server exist, so the maintainer of a dataset copy honours the list at build time

refusals.verifier: the package fails contrib/verify.mjs (any rule); the first failing rule is named
refusals.privacy: an episode carries a forbidden key (address, age, audio, biometric, birthdate, camera, ...), an email-shaped string or free text - the same scan contrib.json#privacy declares, applied to /1 packages too
refusals.classroom: a /2 package whose origin.classroom_mode is not false (the verifier refuses it first)
refusals.licence: every admitted package must carry consent.license CC-BY-4.0 (contrib/ fixes one licence for every package); a package under any other id is refused by name, so the dataset licence is that one licence and its attribution list names every admitted package by digest (and wallet address, when signed)
refusals.consent-scope: a dataset is built FOR one declared scope; a package is admitted only if its consent.scope includes it, otherwise it is refused by name (consent-scope)
refusals.revoked: a package digest or an episode id on the list is excluded from every later build, by name, and the manifest records how many were excluded and why. It cannot recall a copy already given away: those are governed by the licence.
refusals.duplicate: a package whose digest.hex was already admitted is skipped as a duplicate, by name

privacy.forbidden_keys_note: a partial list written here, matched case-insensitively at every depth of every episode; a key it does not list is not thereby proven harmless
privacy.free_text_why: every string an episode legitimately carries is an id, a short gauge label or an ISO time; a string longer than this is treated as free text and refused
privacy.claimed: in a /2 package contributor.claimed is null (unsigned) or the signing wallet address - never a label a person typed, which may be their name
privacy.applies_to: tc-contribution/2 packages; a tc-contribution/1 package is verified exactly as before, and the dataset builder (datashare/build_dataset.mjs) applies the same scan to /1 packages before it admits them

classroom: K-12 / classroom mode: recording and sharing are not offered at all

outlier.rule: robust z = 0.6745 * (x - median) / MAD over the episodes of one env (world) or seat (sim); |z| > 3.5 is flagged; skipped (and said so) when an env has fewer than 5 episodes or MAD is 0

best_practices.what: every package names its record tag (tc-contribution/1 or /2), every world episode its kind version v, the dataset its tag tc-dataset/1 and the schema versions it admitted

template.title: Motivation
lines: Why: example episodes from this bundle's SCHEMATIC simulators and AUTHORED robotics arenas, shared on purpose by learners who ticked a consent scope, for exercising training and evaluation pipelines.
Scope this dataset was built for: {{scope}}.
Trained on it so far: nothing. {{trained}}

template.title: Composition
lines: {{episodes}} episodes from {{packages}} admitted package(s); by kind: {{by_kind}}.
World episodes by env: {{by_env}}. Coverage gaps: {{gaps}}.
No personal data: no name, email, free text, precise location, audio, camera or biometric field (refused at build).

template.title: Collection process
lines: Recorded device-locally by the training recorder (opt-in per episode), exported by the learner as a contribution package with a fixed consent statement and licence, verified by contrib/verify.mjs.
Actors: {{actors}}. Scripted-reference episodes are demonstrations of a hand-written policy, not learned behaviour.
K-12 / classroom mode: sharing is not offered at all; a package that says otherwise is refused.

template.title: Preprocessing
lines: Episodes are carried verbatim. Deduplicated by content digest ({{duplicates}} duplicate episode(s) removed); {{revoked}} episode(s) excluded by the revocation list; {{refused}} package(s) refused by name.
Range and outlier flags are reported, not corrected: {{flags}}.

template.title: Uses
lines: Suited to: exercising a pipeline's plumbing, format handling and evaluation code on schematic data.
Not suited to: training a controller for real equipment or a real robot; the dynamics are AUTHORED / SCHEMATIC. {{formats}}

template.title: Distribution
lines: Nothing is uploaded by this bundle; a dataset directory is written where the maintainer runs the builder.

template.title: Maintenance
lines: Manifest digest: {{manifest_digest}}. Rebuild with the same packages and revocation list to reproduce it.

card.style: datasheet-style sections; every {{slot}} is filled from the manifest and the analysis, never typed

intake.flag_default: off: unless the Worker env sets DATASHARE_INTAKE to "on" the route answers 404 like an unknown path
intake.key_rule: content-addressed: packages/sha256/<digest.hex>.json - a second POST of the same package finds the key present and stores nothing new
intake.accepts_why: only a /2 package states origin.classroom_mode; a /1 package cannot prove it was not exported in classroom mode, so the intake refuses it by name (the verifier and the dataset builder still accept it)
refuses: unconsented: empty or foreign scope, wrong statement or licence (422)
intake.status: NOT DEPLOYED and OFF by default; tested only against a mocked R2 bucket (datashare/test.mjs)
intake.logs: nothing: no body, no header, no address

v2-agent-only.exercises: consent-scope when built for robot-training; admitted for agent-training

v1-email.exercises: privacy: a /1 package the /1 verifier passes, refused by the dataset scan

v2-reexport.exercises: admitted; every episode is a duplicate of good-v2 by content digest
